walkthrough: Goal: after the G2 exit, pick colours with a loupe that shows what I am about to take, see what the eraser takes while I press, and keep the reference picture out of the way until I want to handle it.

Picking: tap the eyedropper in the side bar and touch the canvas or the reference picture. A 76-point loupe floats up and to the right of the finger or pen (below it near the screen's top), drawn as paper with an ink outline: its top half is the colour under the contact now, its bottom half the current colour, which does not change yet. Moving updates the top half; moving over a control or off the picture keeps the last colour shown while the loupe follows. Lifting makes the last colour shown the current colour (never one where the hand drifted to), it joins the recent ones, the eyedropper turns off and the tool before comes back. Lifting before any colour showed keeps the eyedropper on. A cancelled contact ends the eyedropper and keeps the colour.

Pressing: the pen's hover outline stays as before. While the brush draws there is no outline: the ink under the tip is the feedback. While the eraser presses, its outline shows at the size it erases at that pressure, so I see what goes. Over controls and with a finger down no outline shows.

Reference window: the picture floats at the lower right with no title bar. A single tap on it shows a slim bar across its top (a move grip at the left, × at the right) and a resize mark in its corner; dragging the bar moves the whole window, dragging the mark resizes it, × closes it. The bar hides again after three seconds without a touch on the window, or with a touch anywhere outside it. Inside the picture one finger drags the image about and two fingers pinch-zoom it about their middle (1x to 8x) after the canvas's dead zones; the canvas never pans or zooms with them, and the pen never paints there. With the eyedropper on, the picture picks with the loupe like the canvas.

Undo: picking, the loupe, the outline and the window change nothing in the artwork and are no history steps; the strokes drawn undo as before. Reopen: the colour picked is stored with the toolbox; the reference window is gone after the system closed the app, as before.
Not here: transition animations, touch-and-hold to pick, the pen's buttons or eraser end, storing the reference or the window's place.
